evaluations.scenario: User requests help refactoring legacy C++98 code to modern C++20
evaluations.expected_behavior: Agent should read references/1_basics_and_modern_cpp.md and suggest using smart pointers and move semantics.

evaluations.scenario: User asks to optimize a nested for-loop using CUDA or OpenMP
evaluations.expected_behavior: Agent should consult references/2_optimization_and_parallelism.md, propose either OpenMP pragmas or a CUDA kernel, and handle memory properly.
success_criteria: Provides correctly scoped OpenMP pragmas or CUDA block/grid dimensions
Handles data sharing/private variables or Host-to-Device memory copy
Agent explains the performance bottleneck and the solution

success_criteria: Sets up cudaStream_t for asynchronous inference
